messages:
sam: Initiating staged rollout r-2026.04.01-rc1 -> 3 waves (2% each). deploy id=20260401-rc1. Deploybot will request stop/go at each wave.
deploy-bot: Wave1 (2%) started -> region: na-west. variant=r-2026.04.01-rc1. logs: https://redwood.internal/deploy/20260401-rc1
molly: Quick smoke: p50/p95 fine but embeddings p99 in na-west jumped +180ms and 5xx rose +0.8% after wave1. dashboard: https://dash/reports/6300000000
henry: I see RSS climb on embed pods and 1 OOM restart on pod-873. build includes tokenizer bump from hf/tokenizer v2.1 -> v2.3.
deploy-bot: Automated rollback timer set for na-west in 25m. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 6300000000-rollback`
sam: Let's avoid a full region rollback if possible. Propose routing embeddings back to previous variant for na-west (route-split) while leaving textgen on rc1. Can we do that quickly?
molly: Route-split + KV purge sounds right. Target embeddings -> v2026-03-29 in na-west.
ops-bot: Executing route split: `/ops route-split --region na-west --service=embeddings --target=v2026-03-29 --reason "mem-regression"`
deploy-bot: Route-split applied. embeddings now routed to v2026-03-29 in na-west; textgen remains on r-2026.04.01-rc1.
henry: After split + quick KV purge: p99 back to baseline, 5xx dropped to 0.1%. pods stable. Good signal.
sam: Cancelling automated rollback now. `/deploy cancel 6300000000-rollback`
deploy-bot: Rollback canceled by human action.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-512 opened (owner: molly). Summary: embedding memory regression tied to tokenizer lib bump. Mitigations: regional embed pin, KV purge, add mem-delta preflight, add CI mem regression test.
molly: Updating release notes: "na-west: embeddings pinned to v2026-03-29 due to memory regression in r-2026.04.01-rc1; textgen remains on rc1. Investigating tokenizer change."
sam: Proceeding with wave2 to eu-central and ap-northeast with safety-latches enabled. Keeping this stop/go thread open for 12h. Thanks all.
